reason: In the patched src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py, OAuthLoginView.dispatch binds `request.GET["installation_id"]` into pipeline state (patch lines 97-99) before and regardless of the state check. That check only compares against `pipeline.signature`, which is a fixed md5 of the pipeline view class names (src/sentry/pipeline/base.py:132-133). So a crafted callback URL carrying an attacker's installation_id and code sets both the installation sender and github_authenticated_user that GitHubInstallation then compares (patch lines 149-155, 234-239).
